```yaml
name: E2E Portals

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  e2e-portals:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        rust-version: [1.56, 1.58]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust ${{ matrix.rust-version }}
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        profile: minimal
        toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust-version }}
        override: true

    - name: Cache Cargo registry and packages
      uses: actions/cache@v2
      with:
        path: ~/.cargo/registry
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

    - name: Cache target directory
      uses: actions/cache@v2
      with:
        path: ~/.cargo/target
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-target-

    - name: Build tavern, imixv2, and bin/socks5
      run: cargo build --release --package tavern --package imixv2 --package bin/socks5

    - name: Start infrastructure
      run: |
        ./target/release/tavern &
        ./target/release/imixv2 &

    - name: Install Playwright
      run: npm install -g playwright

    - name: Run Playwright test
      run: npx playwright test tests/e2e/tests/portal.spec.ts

    - name: Retrieve Portal ID via GraphQL
      id: get_portal_id
      run: |
        curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query": "{ portals { id } }"}' http://localhost:8080/graphql | jq -r '.data.portals[0].id'

    - name: Start SOCKS5 proxy with retrieved Portal ID
      run: ./target/release/bin/socks5 --portal-id ${{ steps.get_portal_id.outputs.id }}

    - name: Start mock HTTP server
      run: python -m http.server 8000 &

    - name: Verify data integrity by transferring a file through the proxy and comparing checksums
      run: |
        echo "testfile" > testfile.txt
        md5sum testfile.txt > testfile.md5
        curl -x socks5h://localhost:1080 http://localhost:8000/testfile.txt -o received_testfile.txt
        md5sum received_testfile.txt > received_testfile.md5
        if diff testfile.md5 received_testfile.md5; then
          echo "Data integrity verified"
        else
          echo "Data integrity verification failed"
          exit 1
        fi
```
